articles.title: Polish Olympic chief arrested as prosecutors probe suspected crypto-linked bribe
articles.snippet: Prosecutors are probing allegations that Zondacrypto's CEO gave Radosław Piesiewicz a 40,000 euro watch for help with regulatory hurdles.

articles.title: Polish Olympic chief charged in Zondacrypto probe, justice minister says
articles.snippet: Polish Olympic Committee president Radosław Piesiewicz faces charges as prosecutors investigate his ties to collapsed cryptocurrency exchange Zondacrypto.

articles.title: UK Police Seize $1.4M in Bitcoin Traced to Shuttered Darknet Markets
articles.snippet: The 20.21 BTC was linked to marketplaces running between 2016 and 2019, and the man who held it died before it was forfeited.

articles.title: Flock CEO Asks Americans to 'Compromise' on Privacy as Camera Backlash Grows
articles.snippet: Garrett Langley says 99.9% of police are good actors, days after a report identified at least 69 officials accused of misusing plate readers.
